items.note: Agent places ACSR metal and both-pass dP failure at 11:20-11:22 before AWSR and fire spread, identifying ACSR as first failure.
Agent identifies accumulated thermal fatigue, ROC limits and 2007-2015 leaks, but adds a that-night thermal-shock/curtailment final trigger the engineers ruled out.

Agent discusses sealed vents trapping fluid in blocked layers, but calls ACSR vent state unknown and omits the 2015 layers 1/2/98/99, 97-to-98 leak, warming expansion to ~705 psig and cap-sheet separation scenario.
Agent requires MOC/manufacturer approval for blocking and states vent holes must be left open or silicone-filled, never welded sealed.

Agent warns against operating on leak history and considers retirement/replacement, but proposes implementing an LBB programme rather than rejecting leak-before-break as insufficient with hierarchy-of-controls and preemptive-replacement criteria.

Agent addresses ROC monitoring and the ~10x metal under-reading, but prioritises metal-T alarms with stream only qualitative and omits the 14.25 F/min alarm, sensor-placement clarification, lifetime data retention and industry-wide data sharing.
